setting: the walk down the hill at twenty past eight on the first morning of six days off, birds loud in the hedge, his steps slower than usual, one long stop where he counts something out to himself and then loses count, the word april said twice in a flat tone

her kitchen in the middle of a holiday afternoon, folders being squared off on the table between sentences, the radio very low in another room, a chair scraped back halfway through, her voice starting tired and getting faster as she lists what is left

the hill after the fourth night in a row, wind across the microphone, a gate latch, two long silences where he only breathes, a delivery lorry reversing somewhere below, the last sentence started three times and abandoned

the bottom of the hill on the last morning of april, rain just starting on his hood, a bus door hissing shut behind him, the roster paper mentioned and rustling in a pocket, the word may repeated four times, each one lower than the one before
